estimates.assumptions: 5 medium onions at ~125g each when thinly sliced (standard medium onion ~110-130g; slicing doesn't change mass).
2 medium-large tomatoes at ~150g each when finely chopped (typical tomato weight range 100-200g).

2 medium green chillies at ~10g each (standard fresh chilli weight).
1 cup yogurt ≈245g (standard US cup weight for plain yogurt).
1 tsp garam masala ≈2g (typical density for ground spice blends); ~300 kcal/100g average for dry spice mixes.
'To taste' prevents reliable mass estimate; negligible calories anyway.
